checks.text: On initial load, the page shows the heading "Tic Tac Toe", the text "Player X's turn", and the score line "X: 0, O: 0, Draws: 0".
Clicking the cell in row 1, column 1 places an "X" in that cell, changes the turn indicator to "Player O's turn", and the cell is no longer clickable.
Playing X (1,1), O (2,1), X (1,2), O (2,2), X (1,3) completes the top row: the page displays "Player X wins" and the score line "X: 1, O: 0, Draws: 0".
After that win, clicking the empty cell (3,3) does not change the board, and the text "Player X wins" remains visible.
Clicking the button "Restart" after that win clears the board, resets the turn indicator to "Player X's turn", and keeps the score line as "X: 1, O: 0, Draws: 0".
Playing X (1,1), O (1,2), X (1,3), O (2,2), X (2,1), O (2,3), X (3,2), O (3,1), X (3,3) fills the board with no line of three: the page displays "Draw" and the score line "X: 0, O: 0, Draws: 1".
After that draw, clicking the button "Reset Scores" sets the score line to "X: 0, O: 0, Draws: 0" and clears the board.
Pressing the key "1" while the board has focus places an "X" in cell (1,1), and pressing "5" then places an "O" in cell (2,2).

Reload keeps the score and board state: after playing X at (1,1) and O at (1,2), reloading the page still shows "X" in cell (1,1), "O" in cell (1,2), the turn indicator "Player X's turn", and the score line "X: 0, O: 0, Draws: 0".
Playing X (1,1), O (2,2), X (3,3) does not end the round: no "wins" text is shown and the turn indicator reads "Player O's turn".
Playing X (1,1), O (1,3), X (1,2), O (2,2), X (3,3), O (3,1) completes a diagonal for O: the page displays "Player O wins" and the score line "X: 0, O: 1, Draws: 0".
Playing X (1,1), O (1,2), X (2,1), O (2,2), X (3,1) completes the first column: the page displays "Player X wins".
